items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Those records I told you about made with Jeanette and Jim Robinson, George Lewis, Paul Barberin.

ctx.x: Did you ever make any records for Southland?

Those records I told you about made with Jeanette and Jim Robinson, George Lewis, Paul Barberin. But I don't think those records were ever released. I don't know what happened to them. I know we made them. We went up there one day and we cut about six sides or something. Four either six sides. Had a couple of them that Jeanette sang. But after it was released I don't know because I never did hear them anywhere. Of course I made a lot of records when I was in service but they wasn't for the general public. I don't…
We had a radio show. Bob Poole was master ceremony.
